Name: Better Artisan Good Icons for The Love of Cooking
Author: TiddlyWinkly
Description:
Just a content pack I made for The Love of Cooking mod's artisan goods. Tried making the icons as unique as possible to fit in with all the others in BAGI, feel free to tell me if something is off.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]Better Artisan Good Icons[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url] mod, otherwise it won't do anything
And SMAPI of course

Installation:
Throw it in your mods folder
